description: Makes the pack to take on the shoot day: the call sheet with, for each scene, its shots, the action, the look and the sound notes. Use it when the crew needs one document to work from; use shoot_plan_call_sheet when only the times and people are wanted. Input: plan, a dpl.plan/1 object that validates; optionally day, the id of one day in the plan's schedule (a day the plan does not have is refused, and the refusal lists the days it has). Output: dpl.shoot-pack/1. No AI model runs; we don't keep the plan. Needs an agent key from a Shoot Plan account, and is free up to 3 projects a month. A project is identified by the plan's work id and title; it counts when this tool first makes a finished document for it that month. shoot_plan_allowance says what is left. Over the limit it answers ALLOWANCE_REACHED: do not retry, a new key will not help, tell your human. A fair-use limit also applies: up to 20 finished-document calls for any one project and 60 for the account each month. To count projects we keep, against your account, a one-way fingerprint (hash) of the project's id and title, the month, how many finished documents were made and when, for 13 months after the end of that month. Plans up to 8 MB and 120 calls a minute (5,000 a day).

day.description: Optional: the id of one shoot day in the plan's schedule, for example day1. Leave it out for the whole schedule.

plan.description: The plan itself: a dpl.plan/1 JSON object (not text inside a string). Call shoot_plan_format for the schema links and an example.

name: shoot_plan_shoot_pack
title: Make the shoot-day pack from a plan
